## Summary by cubic
Changes saved REST and GraphQL example responses to accept JSON-with-comments (JSONC) annotations, such as `//` and `/* */` comments, preserving them through prettifying, saving, copying, and downloading. Live API responses remain read-only and keep lossless formatting.

- Adds a prettify button to editable JSON response bodies.
- Switches example editors to a JSONC linter so comments don't surface as errors.
- `prettifyJSONCWithValidation` validates input before formatting, so malformed bodies are left untouched and reported as errors instead of being silently changed.
